architecture.mechanism: Crankshaft flexure under peak combustion load creates transient edge-loading on main and rod bearings, locally exceeding hydrodynamic film thickness and initiating metal-to-metal contact that propagates to catastrophic seizure.
architecture.intervention: Replace standard smooth-journal crankshafts with micro-hydrodynamic textured journals (laser-etched micro-dimples) combined with sputtered diamond-like carbon (DLC) tribo-coatings on the bearing shells to maintain localized fluid pressure pockets during shaft deflection.
architecture.expected_effect: Minimum oil film thickness increases by at least 40 percent under maximum torsional deflection, eliminating boundary lubrication regimes and preventing bearing material extrusion or spin.
architecture.falsification_test: Run a standard production engine block fitted with the textured DLC hardware on a dynamometer using degraded low-viscosity oil at sustained redline torque; if any bearing shows copper exposure or dimensional loss after 100 hours, the architecture is falsified.
